items.name: b11906
items.body:
<details open>

ggml-cpu : rewrite concat as one row kernel for all types (#31179)

Every dst row comes from src0 or src1, or for dim 0 from the row of
src0 followed by the row of src1, so a single kernel covers every
type: a dense source row is one memcpy, quantized types included,
and a strided source is copied element by element with the element
size known at compile time.

Rows are split across threads instead of i2 alone, which is often 1,
and are copied in tiles of 32: for a transposed source the elements
are walked in the outer loop, so the rows of a tile read neighboring
addresses instead of jumping a full row stride per element.

Add transposed b cases to test_concat, the layout of the delta-net
conv input, and a perf case for it.

</details>

items.name: Release: v5.21.0
items.body: # Release v5.21.0 ## New Model additions ### MiniCPM-OCR MiniCPM-OCR is a document-understanding model from OpenBMB's MiniCPM-V family. It keeps the MiniCPM-V 4.6 architecture, which pairs a SigLIP vision encoder and a window-attention merger with a Qwen3.5 language model. It is specialized for reading text-dense images such as scanned pages, screenshots, receipts and tables. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/minicpm_ocr) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2509.18154) * Feat test (#49920) by @guarin in [#49920](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49920) ### Flint Flint is Recursive's mixture-of-experts language model. Compared to a standard SwiGLU MoE transformer such as Qwen3-MoE, it uses hybrid attention (sliding-window attention with rotary embeddings over the current token and the previous 512 tokens in most layers, and full attention without positional encoding in the remaining layers). It also has learned attention sinks, as in GPT-OSS, with per-head RMS-normalized queries and keys. Each sparse layer routes a token to 6 of 256 experts by sigmoid score and adds an ungated shared expert, and the first two layers are dense. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/flint) * Add Flint model support. (#49824) by @lovishmadaan in [#49824](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49824) ### UltraVBert UltraVBert extends ModernVBert by pairing the UltraBERT text encoder with a SigLIP vision encoder for visual document understanding and retrieval.
